name.la: De fide Trinitatis et de incarnatione Verbi
name.en-US: On the Incarnation of the Word

description.la: Epistola Anselmi ad Urbanum papam de incarnatione Verbi, contra Roscelinum, quae in Migne «De fide Trinitatis» inscribitur. Textus ex editione Migne (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853).
description.en-US: Anselm’s letter to Pope Urban II against Roscelin of Compiègne on the Trinity and the incarnation of the Word, printed by Migne as “On the Faith of the Trinity” (the later recension). Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A carta de Anselmo ao papa Urbano II contra Roscelino sobre a Trindade e a encarnação do Verbo, impressa por Migne como «Sobre a fé na Trindade».

sources.edition: S. Anselmi Cantuariensis archiepiscopi opera omnia, ed. J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 158 (Paris 1853), the Gerberon text; TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text 10610, from the Open Greek and Latin machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with its chapter divisions and PL chapter summaries. PL page breaks, the column numbers and the apparatus of alternative chapter numbers (al.) are dropped; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Anselm died in 1109; Migne’s 1853 printing is public domain everywhere.
